content.value_statement: Claude rule files are easy to confuse with Cursor rules. This skill gives exact frontmatter, path scoping, and examples for reliable Claude Code rules.
actual_capabilities: Explains how .claude/rules files load as modular project instructions.
Shows the correct Claude paths frontmatter for scoped rules.
Distinguishes Claude rule fields from Cursor globs and alwaysApply fields.
Provides examples for scoped rules, global rules, and single path patterns.
Lists common glob patterns and the files they match.
limitations: Does not create or modify files by itself.
Covers Claude modular rules, not every Claude configuration file.
Does not validate glob behavior against a live repository tree.
Depends on the current Claude Code rule format remaining compatible.

use_cases.title: Create project rules
use_cases.description: Add clear Claude rules for TypeScript, tests, frontend code, or other repository areas.

use_cases.title: Repair incorrect frontmatter
use_cases.description: Replace Cursor-style fields with Claude paths frontmatter and quoted glob patterns.

use_cases.title: Plan a rule structure
use_cases.description: Organize global and path-scoped rules into a maintainable .claude/rules directory.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic rule
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new scoped rule.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Claude rule for TypeScript files in src and tests. Use the correct .claude/rules format and explain where to place it.

prompt_templates.title: Fix rule frontmatter
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Claude rule frontmatter and fix any Cursor-only fields. Keep the rule scoped to the same files.

prompt_templates.title: Migrate Cursor rules
prompt_templates.scenario: Move existing project rules into Claude format.
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert these Cursor rules into Claude modular rules. Use paths where needed and explain which rules should be global.

prompt_templates.title: Design a rules directory
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for a larger repository.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a .claude/rules structure for a monorepo with API, frontend, tests, and documentation. Recommend filenames, scopes, and rule boundaries.

output_examples.input: A user asks for a TypeScript rule that applies to source and test files.
output: A concise rule title and instruction body.
A description of the correct paths frontmatter with quoted glob patterns.

output_examples.input: A repository has Cursor-style globs and alwaysApply fields.
output_examples.output: The skill identifies the Cursor fields, replaces globs with Claude paths, and recommends omitting paths for global instructions.

output_examples.input: A team wants separate guidance for frontend, tests, and API code.
output_examples.output: The skill proposes a recursive .claude/rules layout with named rule files and scoped path patterns.

best_practices: Quote glob patterns in Claude rule frontmatter.
Use path-scoped rules for instructions that only apply to specific files.
Omit paths for global rules instead of using Cursor-only fields.
anti_patterns: Using globs or alwaysApply in Claude rule frontmatter.
Copying Cursor rule metadata without checking Claude support.
Creating broad scoped rules when a global rule is clearer.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create and fix modular Claude rules stored under .claude/rules.

faq.question: Does it support Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance is written for Claude Code modular rules.

faq.question: Can it migrate Cursor rules?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains how to replace Cursor fields with Claude-compatible rule structure.

faq.question: Should global rules include paths?
faq.answer: No. The skill recommends omitting paths for rules that should always apply.

faq.question: Does it run commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill is documentation and guidance only.

faq.question: Can it verify every glob match?
faq.answer: No. It explains patterns, but repository-specific validation still requires local checking.
